name: RenkoChart
summary: RenkoChart is a utility Expert Advisor that generates and maintains a custom Renko chart offline by processing tick data from a standard symbol. It creates bricks of a fixed size and outputs them as offline chart bars, allowing traders to visualize price movement in Renko format without opening any trading positions.
summary_zh: RenkoChart是一个工具型EA，通过处理标准品种的tick数据来生成和维护自定义Renko砖形图离线图表。它按照固定砖块大小创建砖形并输出为离线图表的K线，帮助交易者以Renko格式观察价格走势，本身不执行任何交易操作。
strategy_analysis: RenkoChart本身不包含任何交易策略，它是一个纯粹的图表生成工具。其核心功能是监听实时tick数据，根据预设的砖块大小（BoxSize）判断是否形成新的Renko砖块。当价格移动超过一个砖块大小时，就在离线图表中添加新的K线记录。入场条件和出场条件不适用，因为该EA不进行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理同样不适用。该工具的价值在于为交易者提供不同于传统时间周期图表的价格可视化方式，消除市场噪音，更清晰地展示趋势方向。交易者可以基于生成的Renko图表手动制定自己的交易决策或与其他EA配合使用。
strategy_analysis_en: RenkoChart does not contain any trading strategy; it is a pure chart generation utility. Its core function is to listen to live tick data and determine whether a new Renko brick has formed based on a predefined box size (BoxSize). When price movement exceeds one brick size, a new bar record is added to the offline chart. Entry and exit conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute any trades. Position sizing and money management are similarly not applicable. The value of this tool lies in providing traders with an alternative price visualization method distinct from traditional time-based charts, eliminating market noise and presenting trend direction more clearly. Traders can use the generated Renko chart to manually formulate their own trading decisions or combine it with other EAs for signal generation.

parameters.name: BoxSize
parameters.description: Renko砖块大小（点数），定义价格需要移动多少才能形成新砖块
parameters.description_en: Renko box size in points to form a new brick

parameters.name: RenkoTimeFrame
parameters.description: 离线图表的时间周期标识符，用于生成离线Renko图表
parameters.description_en: Offline chart timeframe identifier for Renko generation

parameters.name: SymbolName
parameters.description: 自定义品种名称，用于创建离线Renko图表的标识
parameters.description_en: Custom symbol name for offline Renko chart

parameters.name: UseClosePrice
parameters.description: 是否使用收盘价而非最高最低价来构建Renko砖块
parameters.description_en: Use close price instead of high/low for Renko bricks

parameters.name: ShowWicks
parameters.description: 是否在Renko砖块上显示影线（高低点延伸）
parameters.description_en: Show wicks (high/low extensions) on Renko bricks

pros: 提供Renko图表可视化，有效过滤市场噪音，帮助识别趋势方向
作为工具型EA不进行交易，安全性高，不会造成资金损失
可以与其他交易策略或EA配合使用，增强整体交易系统的分析能力
pros_en: Provides Renko chart visualization that effectively filters market noise and helps identify trend direction
As a utility EA it does not trade, ensuring high safety with no risk of capital loss
Can be combined with other trading strategies or EAs to enhance the analytical capability of the overall trading system
cons: 仅生成离线图表，无法在策略测试器中直接回测基于Renko的交易策略
依赖实时tick数据，在数据不足或市场清淡时可能无法正确生成砖块
离线图表在某些MT5版本中可能存在刷新延迟或兼容性问题
cons_en: Only generates offline charts, making it impossible to directly backtest Renko-based trading strategies in the strategy tester
Depends on live tick data, which may fail to generate bricks correctly when data is insufficient or the market is thin
Offline charts may experience refresh delays or compatibility issues in certain MT5 versions
improvements: 增加对历史数据的支持，允许在策略测试器中模拟生成Renko图表以便回测
添加基于Renko砖块的自动信号生成功能，如连续同色砖块计数或反转砖块警报
improvements_en: Add support for historical data to allow simulated Renko chart generation in the strategy tester for backtesting purposes
Add automatic signal generation based on Renko bricks, such as consecutive same-color brick counting or reversal brick alerts

risk_points: 离线图表刷新延迟可能导致交易者基于过时信息做出决策
依赖持续运行的EA来维护图表，EA意外停止会导致图表数据中断
risk_points_en: Offline chart refresh delays may cause traders to make decisions based on stale information
Depends on a continuously running EA to maintain the chart; unexpected EA termination will interrupt chart data

It creates bricks of a fixed size and outputs them as offline chart bars, allowing traders to visualize price movement in Renko format without opening any trading positions.
